newsitem.title: USA: D&P reaffirms Provident Life ratings.
newsitem.headline: D&P reaffirms Provident Life ratings.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Monday it reaffirmed the claims paying ability rating of Provident Cos' Provident Life & Accident Insurance Co and Provident National Assurance Co.
It also removed these ratings from rating watch-uncertain.
These ratings were placed on rating watch after the parent company said it was acquiring Paul Revere Corp in a $1.2 billion transaction. The merger closed March 27.

Based on a review of the situation, Duff & Phelps concluded the merger has the potential for substantial unit cost reductions, new operational efficiencies and marketing synergies for the combined companies.
